title: The last flight.
text: You are flying supplies across Ashen Valley. Below, the last road disappears into the mountains.

title: Into the white.
text: A sudden squall swallows the ridge. Your radio dies as the aircraft loses height.

title: No way back.
text: The wreck settles among the pines. You survive, but the valley is silent and the way out is gone.

title: What remains.
text: You salvage a knife and a few supplies. Shelter, safe water, and warmth come before any journey.

variants.riverborn: You wake beside the river and recover an extra supply bag. Shelter, safe water, and warmth come first.
variants.cold_trail: By dusk, rain has soaked your clothes. You salvage a knife and a few supplies. Make a dry camp before night.

title: One signal.
text: A ranger trail leads to an abandoned station. Find a radio, reach the summit, and call for rescue.
